description: Application for the change of use of existing buildings, to provide 628 student bed spaces with ancillary facilities and Class E floorspace at ground floor, along with construction of canopy structure to link the two existing blocks, provision of blue badge spaces and cycle parking, public realm, landscaping and other associated works.
